question: What digital photos must an Express Entry applicant provide for an e-APR?

claims.text: An Express Entry applicant must provide digital photos that meet IRCC permanent resident card photo specifications.
claims.quote: Digital photos meeting [IRCC’s permanent resident card photo specifications (PDF, 614.24 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/information/applications/guides/pdf/5445eb-e.pdf) must be provided.

basis: The submitted document 96122ac7bfc0f2e0b1b13daf962a2fc0.pdf was reviewed for slot digital_photo under Express Entry permanent resident card photo specifications.
prose: An Express Entry applicant must provide digital photos that comply with IRCC permanent resident card photo specifications.
